These files match the NetFilter runtime committed in Netch 1.9.7:
https://github.com/netchx/netch/tree/99480e99c3f5f4b0f6c4a32fdbbb4911be2a3687
nfapi.dll: Redirector/static/nfapi.dll
nfdriver.sys: Storage/nfdriver.sys

File checksums and upstream identifiers are recorded in NetFilter-SOURCE.json.
This package does not include NetFilter SDK source, headers or import libraries.
